target: frozen Phase 002D-R2 metrics, thresholds, abstention, mutation, and budget arithmetic

findings.claim: Hindsight exclusion is asserted by booleans, but the threshold policy does not hash-bind its metric registry, protocol, or cited rationale artifacts into one pre-result freeze record; replacement after results is therefore not disproved by these files alone.
findings.recommended_test: TP-T1: freeze a joint manifest of all policy inputs, commit and order-before-attempt evidence; mutate each bytewise and require freeze failure plus dependent STALE.

findings.claim: No complete decision function is stated, while targeted detection, claim-support recall, reproduction success, completion, and terminal failure thresholds are marked compensatory. This permits an undefined aggregation path despite correctness being noncompensatory.
findings.recommended_test: TP-T2: fail each correctness/reliability threshold singly while all other metrics pass; deterministic adjudication must reject or abstain exactly as frozen, never average the failure away.

findings.claim: The false-block rule names an exact one-sided noninferiority test but omits alpha, paired statistic, success/failure counts, handling of discordant pairs, and the exact denominator. N_valid and block-precision minima do not uniquely define the calculation.
findings.recommended_test: TP-T3: supply boundary tables with N_valid=20, missing pairs, zero blocks, and discordant pairs; one frozen formula must return the same PASS/FAIL/ABSTAIN reason under independent replay.

findings.claim: Token and elapsed ratios do not define zero or missing baseline denominators. Claim-support formulas max(0.95,baseline+0.10) exceed the unit interval when baseline>0.90, creating an unmarked impossible line rather than a defined abstention or intentional rejection.
findings.recommended_test: TP-T4: evaluate zero/missing denominators and baselines 0.90,0.91,1.00; reject undefined arithmetic and require a frozen domain-valid result or explicit abstention reason.

findings.claim: retry_burden has no numerator or denominator formula. The protocol permits ceil(main starts*0.25) retries while the threshold is 0.10, and absolute_start_cap does not explicitly say whether it is global; valid arithmetic and stop behavior are therefore under-specified.
findings.recommended_test: TP-T5: for eligible counts 0..3, replay primary, infrastructure-retry, per-slot, and cap accounting; every attempt must be counted once and no start may exceed the uniquely declared scope.

findings.claim: mutation_effect states STALE_ALL_DEPENDENT_RESULTS but neither the dependency closure nor mutation coverage for registry, protocol, rationale, formulas, exclusions, and budget fields is specified here.
findings.recommended_test: TP-T6: mutate every policy dependency class after freeze and require all attempts, metrics, audits, decisions, and reports reachable from it to become STALE until full replay.

proposed_rules: Bind metric registry, threshold policy, protocol, all rationale artifacts, candidate set, evaluator/oracle definitions, commit, and freeze ordering in one immutable pre-attempt manifest; any mismatch routes to STALE, not continued scoring.

Freeze one total decision table before results. Every hard-safety and correctness condition is noncompensatory; any intentionally compensatory metric must have an explicit aggregation operator and cannot offset correctness.

Specify false-block numerator, denominator, pairing, discordance handling, alpha, inequality orientation, minimum counts, and undefined cases before execution; otherwise route RETEST_REQUIRED without inventing values.

Range-check every rate threshold in [0,1]. Zero, missing, censored, or mismatched denominators yield the frozen abstention route and are never replaced by zero, infinity, epsilon, or post-result conventions.
Define retry_burden from immutable ledger fields, state whether infrastructure retries count, and distinguish permission to retry from passing the 0.10 cost gate; all attempts remain recorded.
Define cap scope and verify main=eligible_architecture_count*4*2, retries=ceil(main*0.25), at most one retry per slot, and total starts within 30 before each launch.
Hash mutation of any metric, threshold, formula, exclusion, protocol budget, rationale, evaluator, or oracle triggers transitive STALE and complete deterministic replay.
abstentions: No alpha, denominator repair, unit-interval correction, cap scope, or candidate outcome is selected because the allowed frozen inputs do not determine those choices; they require a new pre-result freeze, not prosecutorial invention.
